properties.notes: This is a vacant, former horticultural nursery site in Nelson. The Council's viability model suggests that this type of site is unlikely to be viable to develop. The site has been actively marketed and a planning application has recently been submitted but has since been withdrawn. The owner has returned the Housing Land Survey form indicating that the site is available and development could come forward within 1 year.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
